custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A.
  • Have an untracked part, part A, with vendor A, whose part number, description and tags contain neither the word not nor the word tracked.
  • Have a tracked part, part C, with vendor A, whose part number, description and tags contain neither word, so the search has a part it must leave out.
  • Start on vendor A's page (Parts in the top bar, Vendors in the left menu, then the vendor A row).

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839425-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C839425-, so searching for that finds them all.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A new vendor credit for vendor A opens.

Step 2:

  • The part search under Part Number is ready to type in.

Step 3:

  • Part A is listed: the word tracked finds untracked parts here too.
  • Part C is not listed.
